title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The AI Office has decided to implement a new framework for the responsible use of artificial intelligence. This decision outlines key guidelines, standards, and risk assessment procedures that all AI projects must follow.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This policy outlines the role and responsibilities for technology specialists in AI who will fill vacancies within the AI office. It sets the criteria, expectations, and processes for recruiting and retaining these specialists.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This document announces a job opening for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office. It invites qualified candidates to apply and outlines the role’s responsibilities and expectations.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: The document announces available positions for Legal Officers who will oversee the company’s AI initiatives. It describes the roles, responsibilities, and qualifications needed, with a focus on ensuring legal compliance, risk management, and policy oversight for AI projects.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy explains how to fill vacant positions in the AI office, ensuring that new policy officers are chosen through a clear and transparent process. It also sets out the duties and expectations for those officers to uphold the organization’s AI standards and maintain effective governance.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts set up to review and advise on the European Union's proposed AI legislation, focusing on the scientific and technical aspects of the law. Their role is to provide evidence‑based guidance that helps shape a balanced, realistic policy framework for AI regulation.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The document is a draft request to standardise certain processes or guidelines within an AI system. It likely outlines the proposed standards, the rationale behind them, and the steps needed to implement or adopt them.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: The notice invites stakeholders to take part in a consultation about establishing or updating a Community of Practice (CoP) framework. It outlines the purpose, scope, and timeline for collecting feedback to guide future policy decisions.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: The policy document announces a call for people to express interest in joining a new Community of Practice focused on AI topics. It explains how to submit an expression of interest and outlines the community’s goal of sharing best practices, resources, and collaborative projects.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: The CoP Graphic illustrates how an iterative drafting process works in a community of practice. It shows each step, from initial drafting to feedback loops and finalization, to ensure continuous improvement and stakeholder engagement.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This policy document includes a graphic that maps out the entire drafting process for a Community of Practice. It visually presents the key stages, milestones, and timeline dates that guide how the policy is developed and reviewed.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This document presents the first version of a set of guidelines meant to govern the design, use, and oversight of artificial intelligence systems, focusing on ethical considerations and responsible practices. It serves as an initial framework that stakeholders can review, comment on, and refine in subsequent revisions.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document sets out a draft set of guidelines and standards for the responsible design, development, and use of AI systems. It aims to promote safety, transparency, and accountability while providing detailed principles for stakeholders, and is currently in its second draft stage awaiting review.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The Code of Practice: 3rd Draft sets out guidelines for the responsible use of AI, focusing on transparency, fairness, and accountability. It provides best‑practice recommendations for developers, organizations, and regulators to help ensure AI systems are safe, ethical, and aligned with societal values.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a collaborative framework for responsible AI development and governance. It emphasizes transparency, accountability, and international cooperation to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that sets out the core principles and commitments for the responsible development and use of artificial intelligence. It establishes guidelines for transparency, fairness, safety, and accountability, aiming to ensure AI technologies are deployed in ways that benefit society while mitigating potential risks.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy outlines specific artificial intelligence practices that are prohibited. It serves as a guide for organizations to recognize and avoid activities that violate the outlined restrictions.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This policy outlines how organizations should define what counts as an AI system, including specific characteristics and functions that qualify. It offers practical guidelines for labeling, documenting, and monitoring AI systems to ensure transparency and compliance with regulatory requirements.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: The policy outlines how the government will communicate and support initiatives to boost start‑ups and drive innovation. It focuses on creating partnerships, sharing best practices, and providing resources to help new businesses grow and bring fresh ideas to the market.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start‑Ups aims to support early‑stage companies in the high‑performance computing sector across Europe. It provides resources, mentorship, and access to advanced computing infrastructure to help startups grow and innovate.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This webinar slideshow explains how to identify and assess risks in AI projects. It offers practical strategies for mitigating those risks and ensuring responsible AI use.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: The video is a webinar on risk management, outlining how to identify, assess, and mitigate potential risks in projects. It provides best‑practice strategies and tools to help organizations handle uncertainty and protect their resources.
